text:
ana: Heads-up: Console quota view is showing duplicated route lines after we started emitting x-route-hint for policy routing. Looks like some SDKs include the hint in client-side route keys.
rory: Yikes. Which SDKs?
ana: Mostly TS and Go clients observed in telemetry. Python ignores unknown headers so it's fine.
devon: Root cause: SDKs build a fingerprint from all headers used for routing; x-route-hint was meant to be server-only and non-billed. SDKs must whitelist billing-relevant routing headers.
kevin: Proposed quick fix: change key builder to only include a small whitelist: service, route, x-route-priority. Explicitly ignore x-route-hint and x-delegate-route. Patch will be tiny.
rory: TS patch sketch: ```ts
const keyParts = [svc, route]; if(headers['x-route-priority']) keyParts.push(headers['x-route-priority']); // ignore x-route-hint
return keyParts.join(':');
```
devon: Go + Python to mirror. Add integ test asserting quota burn unchanged when x-route-hint toggled.
ana: Console UX: collapse duplicated lines and show a tooltip "route hint (server-only) - does not affect billing". Product wants not to alarm customers.
kevin: Rollout plan: 1) ship opt-in SDK change behind env var IGNORE_HINT_IN_KEY 2) backend emit x-route-hint for 5% canary tenants 3) 24h observe metrics and quota burn 4) flip env var default and expand.
rory: We'll also add an admin endpoint so Console can list canary tenants to make the badge transparent. No DB migration needed.
devon: CI checklist: unit tests for key builder, e2e that toggles header, changelog entry, and a smoke test for Console grouping.
ops-bot: Created ticket PLAT-9120 "route-hint SDK whitelist" and scheduled maintenance window only if migration needed.
nana: Docs blurb: "Upgrade SDKs to v3.2.0+ to avoid route-hint being included in client-side keys; this prevents duplicate quota lines."
rory: Let's avoid calling it a breaking change in the UI; call it a behavioral clarification with migration steps.
devon: I'll open the TS PR now and tag it `route-key-fix`. Kevin please do Go and Ana handle the Console change.
kevin: On it. Will add warning log when someone enables INCLUDE_ALL_HEADERS_IN_KEY env var.
nana: Thanks team — ping #release-war-room when canary flips.
